old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-xsfy","title":"[review] project-LICHEN-worker6-1hbf: initiator passes CIPHERTEXT_3 instead of PLAINTEXT_3 to transcript_4","description":"In `EdhocInitiator::process_message_2`, `transcript_4` now correctly takes `(TH_3, PLAINTEXT_3, CRED_R)` per RFC 9528, but the initiator passes `\u0026ciphertext_3.0` which contains **ciphertext + tag** (encrypted in place at line 975 via `encrypt_in_place_detached`). The responder correctly passes `\u0026pending.plaintext` (decrypted plaintext). This causes TH_4 mismatch between initiator and responder, breaking OSCORE context derivation (which depends on TH_4).\n\nFix: save a copy of PLAINTEXT_3 (the bstr-encoded pubkey + signature) before the AEAD encrypts it in place, and pass that copy to `transcript_4`.","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"agent@lichen-project.dev","created_at":"2026-07-24T18:24:58.286313787Z","created_by":"AI Agent","updated_at":"2026-07-24T18:24:58.286313787Z"}
